site.name: Lowest Hallowed
site.answer_line: Lowest Hallowed: Christian dark ambient and dungeon synth for prayer, with unblack undertones, composed by Steve Chab. A new album comes out each month, and listeners pray at the same time.
site.share_alt: The Lowest Hallowed Prayer Watch. Once a month, one album, one night.

releases.title: Watchman in the Darkest Hour
releases.line: Four pieces, about an hour long, that move through the watch, the garden, the agony, and the cup.
